purpose: Measure reviewer-package footprint and warm-cache CPU-only offline replay wall time without changing any archived scientific bytes.

protocol.cache_interpretation: The unreported warmup intentionally primes filesystem and interpreter caches; measured values are warm-cache reviewer replay times, not cold-download or cold-page-cache times.
protocol.execution: Run the exact package replay entrypoint as a child process from the package root, capture exit status and SHA-256 of stdout/stderr, and measure wall/user/system seconds for each repetition.
protocol.storage: Recursively count regular files and their logical byte sizes under the frozen package root before replay.
protocol.host_disclosure: Record OS, architecture, CPU brand, logical CPU count, physical memory, and Python version; omit machine hostname and credentials.

validity_gates: the package root and replay entrypoint exist
the replay entrypoint SHA-256 equals the preregistered digest
the result path does not pre-exist
the warmup and all five measured replays exit zero
the package footprint is unchanged before and after measurement
estimands: median child user and system CPU seconds
claim_boundary: This authorizes only storage footprint and CPU-only warm-cache offline replay time on the disclosed Mac host. It does not measure H20 live-capture overhead, cold download time, production latency, throughput, or engineering integration effort.
negative_result_policy: Any failed replay or footprint drift invalidates the timing result and remains registered; it is not silently discarded.
